entries.symptom: A commit is rejected: gated files changed without a Gate-Change trailer (gate-change-missing)
entries.cause: The commit-msg hook requires Gate-Change: <reason> when a gated path changes (configs, limits, goldens, baselines)
entries.fix: Get the reviewer's agreement, then commit the gate change with the trailer; never split the file out to dodge it

entries.symptom: [gate-change-unneeded] a Gate-Change trailer but no gated file
entries.cause: The trailer was added to a commit that touches no gated path, or a path that should be gated is missing from gatedPaths
entries.fix: Drop the trailer; if the file really sets a limit (a perf baseline, a golden), add it to gatedPaths in quality-gates.json with its own Gate-Change commit

entries.symptom: Commit rejected: "Updated stuff." or a scope the rules do not know
entries.cause: Conventional Commits with a known scope are required
entries.fix: feat(<scope>): <imperative summary>, with a scope from the commit rules (a feature folder or one of the repo scopes)

entries.symptom: A commit check fails because the body names no requirement reference, although the hook accepted it
entries.cause: An older hook used a weaker rule set than the repo-wide commit check
entries.fix: Use the canonical commit-message rules for both the hook and the check (one rule set, same ids); report commits already made instead of rewriting shared history

entries.symptom: A commit that touches only an installed skills folder is rejected for a missing Gate-Change trailer
entries.cause: The gated-path globs (**/tsconfig.json, **/__image_snapshots__/**) matched skill templates and fixtures
entries.fix: Match gated paths against whole repo paths and let files under skills/ or the agent folders count only for patterns that start with that folder (the canonical gated-paths helper does)

entries.symptom: Commit refused: a key or signing file is staged (*.p8, *.p12, *.jks, .env)
entries.cause: Keys and signing files are never committed, even with git add -f
entries.fix: Remove the file from the commit; keys live outside the repo. If it was ever pushed, treat it as leaked

entries.symptom: The commit-msg hook fails with spawnSync git ENOBUFS
entries.cause: The hook read the staged diff with the default 1 MB buffer; a large commit exceeds it
entries.fix: Raise maxBuffer on that spawnSync (the canonical check-commit-message.ts does)

entries.symptom: The first commit swept in unrelated files (someone's uncommitted edits, design folders, installed skills)
entries.cause: The bootstrap staged with git add -A
entries.fix: Stage only the files the step created and ask about the rest

entries.symptom: [outcome-first] first line is 255 characters, the limit is 240
entries.cause: The outcome line has limits: at most 240 characters, at most 2 sentences, ending in . or !
entries.fix: Shorten the first line to one plain sentence; move the rest to the next lines

entries.symptom: The pre-commit typecheck passes although the app program has errors
entries.cause: A bare tsc --noEmit checks only the root program
entries.fix: Run npm run -s typecheck (both programs)

entries.symptom: A rule was switched off for one run with eslint --rule
entries.cause: The CLI flag overrides the config
entries.fix: Hooks and CI call only the canonical npm scripts

entries.symptom: The gate guardrail reports "max-params[1]: expected 3, got 5"
entries.cause: A limit in eslint.config.mjs was raised
entries.fix: Restore the limit; limits change only with the reviewer and a Gate-Change trailer

entries.symptom: npm run verify stops at test:sim: "No tests found, exiting with code 1"
entries.cause: The app has no *.sim.test.ts yet, so the simulation project has nothing to run
entries.fix: Remove test:sim from the verify plan until the app has simulations (games plugin), or write them; never add --passWithNoTests to a gate
match: No tests found, exiting with code 1

entries.symptom: npm run <script> fails with Cannot find module <repo>/scripts/... (or the gate-wiring check reports script-target)
entries.cause: package.json names a script whose tooling file is not in the repo yet
entries.fix: Copy the tooling from the skill that owns it (with its test), or remove the script until then

entries.symptom: Lint errors after an edit never reach the agent
entries.cause: A Claude Code PostToolUse hook that exits 0 or 1 is not shown to the model
entries.fix: Print to stderr and exit 2

entries.symptom: The Stop hook keeps blocking and the agent stops anyway
entries.cause: Claude Code caps consecutive Stop-hook continuations
entries.fix: Read stop_hook_active; after the cap, report the failing gate to the developer instead of working around it

entries.symptom: Permissions or plugin entries vanished from .claude/settings.json
entries.cause: The file was replaced instead of merged
entries.fix: Merge keys; never overwrite the file

entries.symptom: Project allow rules are ignored: "Dropped N project-scoped permissions.allow entries - workspace not yet trusted"
entries.cause: Claude Code drops project allow rules until the workspace is trusted
entries.fix: Human step: the developer accepts the trust dialog in the project folder once

entries.symptom: The test-edit check reports a disabled or focused test inside a comment or a string
entries.cause: An older checker read prose ("fit (") as a call
entries.fix: Use the current tdd-workflow check (it masks comments and strings); report lines from older history instead of rewriting it

entries.symptom: The test-edit check reports code-without-test for a fix to a device-only wrapper
entries.cause: The checker saw no device-only marker in the diff
entries.fix: Keep "// device-only: covered by <check>" in the first 6 lines and check with --range or --staged
